why.uz: «A special lens, made of many rings of glass» — koʻp shisha halqalardan.
why.ru: «A special lens, made of many rings of glass» — из множества стеклянных колец.

stem.en: Sailors look up a lighthouse's pattern of flashes in a ______.

why.en: "Sailors look the pattern up in a list, and that tells them where they are."
why.uz: «Sailors look the pattern up in a list» — roʻyxatdan qaraladi.
why.ru: «Sailors look the pattern up in a list» — сверяют по списку.

stem.en: In daylight, a tower can be recognised by the way it is ______.

why.en: "Towers are painted in different ways, for example with red and white stripes, so that they can be recognised."
why.uz: «Towers are painted in different ways ... so that they can be recognised» — boʻyalishi bilan.
why.ru: «Towers are painted in different ways ... so that they can be recognised» — по окраске.

stem.en: Today, lighthouses are checked from time to time by visiting ______.

why.en: "Today, almost all lighthouses are automatic, and they're checked from time to time by visiting engineers."
why.uz: «Checked from time to time by visiting engineers» — vaqti-vaqti bilan muhandislar tekshiradi.
why.ru: «Checked from time to time by visiting engineers» — время от времени их проверяют инженеры.
